Header: Oryza sativa f. spontanea ข้าววัชพืช

Prevention: Use pure seed or certified seeds (if outbreak in next crop change seed)
Clean field implements after and before entering in a field
After harvesting stop planting 2-4 week and release ducks into the field
Preferred method of transplanting is by hand or machine or parachuting
Rotation of rice with another plants (reduce weedy rice problems)
Monitoring: Observe rice plant that are taller, easy shattering, flowering before others, longer awns than others, fewer tillers, brighter leaves than others.
Paddy rice is black or brown or red- brown.
High percentage of red rice in milled rice.
Direct Control: Control weedy rice by hand (in tillering stage) or cut and remove from the field (in flowering stage)
In case of extreme outbreak, stop planting 1 crop to promote the germinated weedy rice and manage by plowing. (more than twice)
Restrictions: Apply herbicides in prepare field before planting / after planting 8-10 days
Before applying herbicides, keep water level at 5 cm (for 3 days) and drain water before sowing. 8-10 days after sowing, keep water level above weedy rice 10- 15 days.
RD recommendation for herbicides dosage, method, and crop stages.
II pretilachlor; butachlor pretilachlor- WHO class
